job.title: Senior Manager, Engineering
job.description: Leads the engineering team building Webflow’s code-native platform, including high-fidelity visual-to-code workflows and coding-agent integration. This player-coach role includes architecture reviews, prototyping, hands-on contributions, hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing technical culture.
responsibilities: Set the technical and product direction for Webflow code-native
Lead the integration of coding agents into the building experience
Own the developer experience of working with Webflow in code
Turn an emerging problem space into a coherent roadmap
Partner closely with product, design, and engineering teams
Stay technically engaged through architecture, design reviews, and hands-on contributions
Hire, coach, and develop engineers while building a high-performing technical culture

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching BA, code generation, language tooling
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
